pactrail_failure_cluster.common_terminal_message: model recovery stopped after 3 consecutive tool turns because every tool request failed
pactrail_failure_cluster.diagnosis: The deterministic controller moved into implementing and restricted read-only discovery after a single focused-read allowance. Both DeepSeek models continued requesting evidence tools, those requests were rejected, and recovery terminated before any production mutation.

metric_caveats: The raw Pactrail result field provider_errors is 1 on each failed run because the runner maps any non-zero Pactrail process exit to that field. Trace inspection shows model transport calls succeeded; the failures were controller tool rejections.
Pactrail's lower tokens, cost, and wall time are caused by early termination and must not be presented as useful-work efficiency.
